## Notebooks

The Data Insight notebooks cover Python basics, Python for data science, and machine learning models such as regression, decision trees, random forests, k-nearest neighbours, k-means, and neural networks. They are being moved to an open repository, free for anyone to use. The link will appear here once it is ready.
